# BDPM Site Services

BDPM Site Services is an excavation contractor in Plymouth, MA specializing in site construction and excavation, septic system installation, Title 5 inspections, sea walls and helical piers.

## Business Information
- Owner: Patrick Howard
- Phone: (508) 989-7101
- Email: patrick@bdpmma.com
- Address: 168 Beaver Dam Rd, Plymouth, MA 02360
- Hours: Mon-Fri 7am-5pm, Sat-Sun closed
- Service Area: Plymouth, MA and the surrounding area (Plymouth Center, North Plymouth, West Plymouth, South Plymouth, Manomet, Cedarville)
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=16000072889164023170

## Services
- Site Construction / Excavation: foundation digs, grading and trenches planned around Dig Safe, ledge and wetlands
- Septic System Installation: systems built to the approved Board of Health design, from soil test to backfill inspection
- Title 5 Inspections: Massachusetts Title 5 septic inspections for home sales
- Sea Walls: sea wall construction for Plymouth waterfront property, planned around the coastal bank, the tides and Conservation Commission permits
- Helical Piers: pier installation for new foundations, additions, decks and porches

## About
BDPM Site Services is owned by Patrick Howard and based at 168 Beaver Dam Rd in Plymouth, MA. It handles five kinds of ground work for residential and commercial properties. A job starts with a site visit and a written estimate that states the scope, price and schedule. Dig Safe (811) notice and any Plymouth Conservation Commission or Board of Health review come before digging.
